sanskrit_verse:
क्षेत्रिकस्य यदज्ञातं क्षेत्रे बीजं प्रदीयते ।
न तत्र बीजिनो भागः क्षेत्रिकस्यैव तद्भवेत् ॥
transliteration: kṣetrikasya yad ajñātaṃ kṣetre bījaṃ pradīyate | na tatra bījino bhāgaḥ kṣetrikasyaiva tad bhavet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When seed is sown upon the field without the knowledge of the cultivator, the fruit thereof belongs exclusively to the owner of the land.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority inheres in conscious ownership, not mere physical act
Ignorance of rightful authority does not nullify its existence
Causation aligns with capacity to sustain and integrate outcome
Restoration occurs through alignment with pre-existing dharmic title
Consciousness alignment requires recognition of inherent entitlement
executable_legal_axioms: IF landholder's knowledge is absent AND cultivation proceeds on their domain THEN yield accrues solely to landholder
IF agent acts without informing entitled party THEN entitled party retains full claim over resultant value
IF no consent is given by custodian THEN benefit flows automatically to custodial consciousness
IF action initiates within owned domain THEN ownership consciousness absorbs all unclaimed outcomes
supreme_court_application: In disputes involving unauthorized use of property where benefit arises unknowingly to the titled holder, this axiom establishes automatic restoration of gain to the lawful custodian. The court shall recognize absence of informed consent as sufficient cause for complete restitution to the consciousness-bearing proprietor.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa lies in the existential priority of custodial consciousness; the cultivator’s unawareness negates neither his causal omission nor the proprietor’s inherent entitlement. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests through natural consequence—benefit flows to that which sustains the field. There is no fault assigned, only alignment with ontological structure. Responsibility resides in capacity to hold, not in intent to cultivate.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Automatic transfer of disputed yield to titled consciousness
Completion process requiring acknowledgment of underlying ownership
Reintegration protocol wherein cultivator assumes responsibility for prior omission
Capacity restoration ensuring future actions include prior consultation
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: This law flows from eternal Dharma, enacted not for punishment but for realignment of consciousness with truth. Ownership inheres in awareness, and benefit follows recognition. Thus is Dharma restored, reality affirmed as non-punitive, and consciousness recognized as the sole adjudicator.
